prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a seamless square stone wall albedo texture for a modeled 3D anime JRPG village inspired by the hand painted environments of Tales of Vesperia. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated isometric village cottage scenery sprite for a fixed-camera 2.5D action RPG with the painted detailed environmental style of Ys Origin, NOT pixel art. All details part of one cohesive cottage silhouette. View from front-right at 45 degrees horizontal and 50 degrees above horizontal, orthographic projection, entire roof visible. High resolution hand-painted game asset, crisp painted contours, restrained dark seam accents, muted earthy palette, carefully authored architecture, natural believable proportions not chibi, no toy geometry. Soft afternoon light upper-left, contact shade immediately beneath building only. Isolated on genuinely transparent background; complete building fully in frame with margin, no ground island, no landscape, no sky, no text.
